recentItems.title: GTA 6 : Playing Every Arcade and Console Game
recentItems.description:
Like many open world games there are a few arcade mini games that can be found within GTA 6. Unlike other games in the series, these mini games are everything but small. Check out gameplay from all four arcade and console games from Grand Theft Auto 6, Bank For Your Buck, Street Trash 3: Dezombifier, Tenebrae Lux, and Time Jackers: Rewind. All four of these games are fully fleshed out experiences that cover multiple genres such as a rogue like twin stick shooter, an arcade hunting sim, a sci-fi action adventure, and a very artsy walking simulator, complete with cornball writing and frustrating puzzles. 
 
00:00 - Street Trash 3: Dezombifier
15:45 - Time Jackers: Rewind
30:00 - Tenebrae Lux
41:27 - Bank For Your Buck
 
All gameplay captured on an Xbox Series X

recentItems.title: GTA 6: 99 Incredible Little Details
recentItems.description:
From gameplay quirks to secrets and Easter eggs, here are 99 incredible little details in Grand Theft Auto 6. Don’t worry, you’ll find no story spoilers here. 

We're finally getting to see what Rockstar has been cooking up for the last decade-and-change. It may be a studio already famous for its unbridled attention to detail, but just how many more tiny flourishes, references, and opportunities for emergent hilarity has Rockstar stuffed into GTA 6? The answer is a lot, so let’s get straight to it: this is 99 incredible little details in GTA 6.

recentItems.title: Darkest Dungeon 2: The Butcher's Asylum - Official Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description:
Take a look at gameplay from Darkest Dungeon 2: The Butcher's Asylum in this trailer for the upcoming DLC. The Butcher's Asylum DLC is a standalone game mode for the gothic roguelike game, which brings endless waves of battle, a new playable hero, and new game features. 

Survive the bloodthirsty whims of a mad crowd! The Butcher’s Asylum invites one and all to step into the spotlight against endless hordes of enemies in a self-contained gladiatorial arena designed to test the player’s mental and physical fortitude.

Darkest Dungeon 2 is out now on PC/Mac/Linux (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. The Butcher's Asylum DLC for Darkest Dungeon 2 will be available on PC and consoles in early 2027.

#IGN #Gaming

recentItems.title: Wuthering Waves: Embers of the Everbright - Official Gameplay Reveal
recentItems.description:
Wuthering Waves launches its brand-new Chapter of the Year “Embers of the Everbright” on December 22nd (UTC+8). In Version 4.0, players will meet two playable Resonators, Anna and Lucielle, and pilot the wearable mech “Strider Mechsuit” with full 360-degree mobility and dive straight into exploration and combat. Rover’s next adventure begins at Buffalo Rock, where a new journey through the New Federation awaits. The footage was captured from a test build and does not reflect the final quality of the game.

#IGN #Gaming
